text_original: ಮುಖ್ಯ ರಸ್ತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಹೊಂಡ ಇದೆ, ವಾಹನಗಳಿಗೆ ಹಾನಿ ಆಗುತ್ತಿದೆ
text_english: There is a large pothole on the main road causing damage to vehicles

text_original: मुख्य सड़क के पास कचरे का ढेर बहुत बड़ा हो गया है और बदबू आ रही है
text_english: The garbage dump near the main road has overflowed and is emitting foul smell

text_original: தெரு விளக்கு கடந்த மூன்று நாட்களாக எரியவில்லை, இரவில் நடக்க மிகவும் கஷ்டமாக உள்ளது
text_english: The streetlight has not been working for the past three days, making it very difficult to walk at night

text_original: పెద్ద చెట్టు రోడ్డుపై పడిపోయింది, వాహన రాకపోకలు నిలిచిపోయాయి, వెంటనే తొలగించాలి
text_english: A large tree has fallen on the road blocking all vehicle movement, needs immediate removal

text_original: There is an open manhole on the footpath near Koramangala 5th Block. It is uncovered and poses a serious danger to pedestrians, especially children.
text_english: There is an open manhole on the footpath near Koramangala 5th Block. It is uncovered and poses a serious danger to pedestrians, especially children.

text_original: ನಮ್ಮ ಬೀದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರಿನ ಪೈಪ್ ಒಡೆದಿದೆ, ರಸ್ತೆ ತುಂಬಾ ನೀರು ನಿಂತಿದೆ, ದಯಮಾಡಿ ತಕ್ಷಣ ರಿಪೇರಿ ಮಾಡಿ
text_english: The water pipe on our street has burst, water is flooding the road, please repair immediately

text_original: मुख्य सड़क पर बड़ा गड्ढा है जिसमें पानी भर गया है, वाहन दुर्घटनाएं हो रही हैं
text_english: There is a large pothole filled with water on the main road causing vehicle accidents
image_description: Wide-angle photo of a road showing a large pothole approximately 1.5 metres wide filled with muddy rainwater. Two-wheeler tyre tracks visible at the edge. Surrounding asphalt cracked and crumbling.

text_original: பள்ளி அருகே குப்பை தொட்டி நிரம்பி வழிகிறது, குழந்தைகளுக்கு உடல்நல அபாயம் உள்ளது
text_english: The garbage bin near the school is overflowing posing a health hazard to children
image_description: Photograph of an overflowing garbage dumpster on a roadside approximately 20 metres from a school gate. Mixed waste including plastic bags, food waste, and cardboard spilling onto the pavement. Stray dogs visible scavenging.

text_original: మా వీధిలో మురుగు నీరు పొంగి పారుతోంది, రోడ్డు మొత్తం నీరు నిండిపోయింది, ఇళ్ళలోకి వస్తోంది
text_english: Drainage is overflowing on our street, the entire road is flooded and water is entering houses

text_original: A massive fallen tree is completely blocking MG Road near Trinity Circle. Emergency services cannot pass. The tree fell during last night's storm.
text_english: A massive fallen tree is completely blocking MG Road near Trinity Circle. Emergency services cannot pass. The tree fell during last night's storm.
image_description: Aerial-perspective photo of a large uprooted tree (approximately 15 metres long) lying across the full width of a 4-lane road. Roots exposed, branches spread across both carriageways. Vehicles backed up on both sides.
